lines.text: How does a traffic light know your car is waiting?
lines.tts_text: [curious] How does a traffic light know... your car is waiting?

lines.text: It can actually feel your car sitting on the road.
lines.tts_text: It can actually feel your car — sitting on the road.

lines.text: Many roads have a hidden sensor under the pavement.
lines.tts_text: Many roads have a hidden sensor... under the pavement.

lines.text: Look near the white stop line. You might see a rectangle cut into the road.
lines.tts_text: Look near the white stop line. You might see a rectangle — cut into the road.

lines.text: That rectangle can be a wire loop hiding under the pavement.
lines.tts_text: That rectangle can be a wire loop, hiding under the pavement.

lines.text: Electricity runs through the wire, making an invisible magnetic field.
lines.tts_text: Electricity runs through the wire... making an invisible magnetic field.

lines.text: When a car stops on top of it, the car changes that field.
lines.tts_text: When a car stops on top of it... the car changes that field.

lines.text: The sensor notices the change and tells the traffic light, "Hey, a car is here."
lines.tts_text: The sensor notices the change, and tells the traffic light: [playful] "Hey — a car is here."

lines.text: Then the light can decide when it is time to let that car go.
lines.tts_text: Then the light can decide when it is time... to let that car go.

lines.text: But some traffic lights use cameras or radar instead.
lines.tts_text: But some traffic lights use cameras... or radar instead.

lines.text: And some simply change because a timer says it is time.
lines.tts_text: And some simply change because a timer says it is time.

lines.text: So next time you stop at a red light, look down at the road.
lines.tts_text: So next time you stop at a red light... look down at the road.

lines.text: That little rectangle might be the hidden sensor that knows you are there.
lines.tts_text: That little rectangle might be the hidden sensor... that knows you are there.

lines.text: The traffic light is not guessing. It is getting a signal from the road.
lines.tts_text: The traffic light is not guessing. It is getting a signal — from the road.
